Combined Sales and Permits Activity

MediumFreeQuerying BasicsSubqueries & CTEs

Build a unified activity feed: 20 most recent DEED sales (label='SALE') + 20 most recent ISSUED permits (label='PERMIT'). For sales show document_date as activity_date, document_amt as amount, label='SALE'. For permits show issuance_date as activity_date, NULL as amount, label='PERMIT'. Order by activity_date descending.
